title: Share value against required return
caption: With a £2 dividend growing 4%, the value is 2/(r − 0.04): £40 at r = 9%. A small rise in the required return cuts the value sharply, and as r approaches the growth rate the value explodes.
alt: A steeply falling curve of share value against required return, passing through (9%, £40).
description: P₀ = D₁/(r − g) with D₁ = £2 and g = 4%.
The curve falls steeply as r rises towards the right and rises sharply as r nears 4%.
